title: Task logs lose lines: a writer rewrites task.jsonl instead of appending; find it, prove it, fix it

chat.text: Three landing lines appended to task logs at 17:37 were gone from disk within 15 seconds; later Servex lines were written on top of the older content. Something holds a task log in memory and writes the whole file, or the merge script replaces a record file with a branch's older copy. A Sonnet task mastermind proves which with a test, fixes it so every task-log write is an append, recovers the lost lines from git, and guards it with the test.
